blocks.title: RISC approach
blocks.text: Typically favours a smaller set of comparatively simple, regular instructions, often using explicit load/store operations.

blocks.title: CISC approach
blocks.text: Can offer complex instructions that express several low-level operations in one instruction, potentially improving code density.

blocks.title: Avoid oversimplifying
blocks.text: Fewer instructions in assembly do not guarantee fewer clock cycles. Actual performance depends on pipelining, decoding, caching and processor design.
